lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Responsibilities If Stopped by Law Enforcement
prompt: What does a driver's signature on a Texas traffic citation legally signify?

options.text: A promise to appear in court or contact court; it is NOT an admission of guilt
A formal confession of criminal guilt forfeiting all rights to trial
An agreement to surrender personal vehicle ownership to the municipality
Immediate consent to have points deducted from personal credit bureau scores
